name: Course Platform
tagline: A course platform: three levels of nesting per page load.
realWorld: A course page needs its modules, and each module its lessons. The engine populates downward from a record and cannot fetch children by foreign key, so the app walks the levels itself. This profile measures that walk.

traffic.desc: the first level of the walk

_note: Load-test manifest for this example. The content types are NOT listed here: perf/export-profiles.mjs reads them from the running engine so they cannot drift from the app. This file declares only what the app itself does not: benchmark-scale seed volumes, the arrival rate, the thresholds, and the weighted request mix.
